messages.subject: Project Northwind — Amendment & Restatement Agreement (first draft)
messages.plaintextBody:
Marcus, Claire,

Please find attached our first draft of the Amendment and Restatement Agreement. It follows the agreed term sheet, with the new Facility B as super-senior, the covenant reset and the waiver of the December defaults. We have left the date and a couple of figures as placeholders pending final confirmation from Marlow's model.

We'd be grateful for your mark-up. Confirmatory security documents (debenture, share charge, legal mortgage over the Coventry freehold) to follow separately.

Kind regards,
Elena Marchetti
Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP
T +44 (0)20 7946 0534
